SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRIPT.title: Script
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRIPT.descript: A special type of status. When you gain a new Script status, the previous Script [gold]ends[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_DOOM_KILL_THRES: That enemy's HP minus its [gold]Poison[/gold], [gold]Burning[/gold], and [gold]Doom[/gold].
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_STACKABLE_SCRIP: When you gain the same [gold]Script[/gold] again, it does not end the current [gold]Script[/gold]; stacks are added instead (upgraded effects are retained).
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_MULTI_TARGET.de: A card that targets ALL enemies or multiple random enemies is called a Multi-target card.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_ENVIRONMENTAL.d: This damage has no source and deals a fixed amount.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRY.title: Scry
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_SCRY.descriptio: Look at the top cards of your draw pile, then discard any number of them.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_COUNTS_AS_PLAYE: Play a card that doesn't exist. It resolves normally.
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_FIT.title: Fit
SUNQIAN_UNIVERSE_KEYWORD_FIT.description: Whenever this would be shuffled into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], place it on the top instead.
This card has [gold]Retain[/gold].
When [gold]Script: Eunuch[/gold] ends, this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
When this card leaves your hand, remove [gold]Eunuch's Message[/gold].
